process_documentation: Fetched the official BKG VG250 state-area layer in EPSG:25832 through WFS 2.0, selected land geometry with GF=4, projected the result into a shared 1536×1536 north-up view box, simplified it deterministically by 0.35 px, and emitted a transparent SVG without raster content, scripts, labels, or invented geography.
notes: Visual inspection of the 1024 px raster proof confirms a correct north-up Germany silhouette, including the North Sea and Baltic Sea islands.
The transparent layer aligns exactly with the federal-state, water, and river proofs in the shared view box.
No text, logo, real person, operational wrongdoing, raster payload, script, or external resource is embedded.
